trial_court: Additional District Judge, 3rd Court, Howrah - Matrimonial Suit No. 430 of 2008
case_name: Ms. Sucharita Biswas v. Respondent — Matrimonial Suit No. 430 of 2008
facts_of_case: Matrimonial proceedings instituted by the petitioner against the respondent on 07.07.2008. Proceedings converted from Hindu Marriage Act to Special Marriage Act on 06.04.2011. Only one witness examined on behalf of the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: The court may dispose of a revisional application without service of notice and copy of the application on the respondent if the respondent will not be prejudiced.
legal_principles.held: Since the petitioner has prayed in this revisional application for expeditious disposal of the matrimonial proceedings, I am of the view that the instant revisional application may be disposed of without service of notice and copy of the application on the respondent who will not be prejudiced for expeditious disposal of the maintenance proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: A court may expedite the process of hearing in a pending case if it has been delayed for more than two years.
legal_principles.held: Since the maintenance proceedings is pending for final hearing for more than two years from the first date of fixing peremptory hearing, learned Additional District Judge, 3rd Court, Howrah will expedite the process of hearing of the Matrimonial Suit No. 430 of 2008 and dispose of the same within a period of three months from the date of communication of this order by fixing date of hearing.

outcome.final_order: Court ordered expeditious disposal of Matrimonial Suit No. 430 of 2008 within three months from date of communication, fixing dates for hearing on a day-to-date basis and without granting unnecessary adjournments.

use_for_drafting: guidelines for expeditious disposal of maintenance proceedings
strategies for revisional applications in matrimonial suits
